component.name: Make a Calendar Studio
component.summary: Design printable calendars and plan schedules offline

description.p: A local-first GTK4 workspace for designing civil calendars, planning years, calculating business dates, exploring retail fiscal periods, generating recurring pay dates and rotating shifts, and exporting vector PDF or SVG documents.
Projects and events are saved locally. Online Make a Calendar resources are optional links that open in the system browser.
First development release with calendar design, local project storage, scheduling calculations, converters, and vector document export.
